items.reason: 'Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit', in seconds: the session locks after 600 seconds with no input. It works on a PC signed in through GCPW, where the DeviceLock CSP fails (IP-926). Enforce may set 60 to 900 seconds, never 0 (no lock). Windows reads it at start-up, so a value Kintsugi sets applies after the next restart.
'Require a password when a computer wakes', plugged in (CONSOLELOCK). Windows asks by default; this keeps it from being switched off.
'Require a password when a computer wakes', on battery (CONSOLELOCK).
